items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: I stayed in Houston, Texas a long time with a fellow by the name of Frank Davis. ... he had a band, a dance band.

ctx.x: In New York, no. There was a funny thing about that. I used to make some kind of run all the time on my horn, and Wilbert sat down and rode it out for me. And they asked me to play again. I said, I can't play again, man. He said, well, that's what you make on your horn all the time. It was funny, but, you know, then times. And I stayed in Houston, Texas a long time with a fellow by the name of Frank Davis. I stood there a long time. Did he have a show, or was he a band leader? No, he had a band, a dance band.…
Was there a fellow named Franky Gibbs? Gibbs, he's playing trombone with us.
